name: BIRD-SQL
intro: BIRD-SQL是一个大规模、跨领域的文本到SQL基准测试，包含12,751个文本-SQL对和95个数据库，总计33.4 GB，覆盖37个专业领域。该基准测试的重点是处理真实世界中的挑战，例如不干净的数据库内容、需要外部知识才能回答的自然语言问题，以及在大规模数据库中SQL查询的效率。
org: The University of Hong Kong, DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group, Tsinghua University, Shanghai AI Laborator
build_method: 95个真实数据库收集与描述, 受训众包提问, 外部知识记录, 双盲SQL标注, 专家执行复核
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格, SQL
build_method_en: 95 Real-database Collection and Description, Trained Crowdsourced Questions, External-knowledge Evidence, Double-blind SQL Annotation, Expert Execution Review
intro_en: BIRD-SQL is a large-scale, cross-domain text-to-SQL benchmark containing 12,751 text-SQL pairs and 95 databases totaling 33.4 GB across 37 professional fields. It focuses on real-world challenges such as noisy database content, natural language questions requiring external knowledge, and the efficiency of SQL queries on large-scale databases.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2305.03111 sections on collecting 95 real relational databases from Kaggle, CTU, and open tables, writing database description files, screening crowdsourcers, question annotation with external knowledge evidence, double-blind SQL annotation, expert examination for SQL validness and text-knowledge-SQL alignment, train/dev/hidden-test splits, and EX/VES-style evaluation.
